title: Resolve configured model names to existing Ollama tags
description: When setup created hash-tagged models (e.g. filemaid-gemma4-26b:vhash) and the config references the untagged name, Ollama returns 404 because no :latest tag exists. Classify and Validate should resolve the configured model name to an existing matching tag via /api/tags before calling /api/chat or /api/generate.

title: Simplify model management to latest tag only
description: Instead of creating unique hash tags and manually cleaning up old versions, create models as model:latest directly. Ollama will overwrite latest when the Modelfile changes. This removes removeOllamaModels, the ollama cp alias step, and stale-version cleanup, making the setup behavior simpler and matching user expectations.
close_reason: Setup now creates model:latest directly; Ollama handles updates and no manual cleanup is needed.

title: Create untagged model aliases during setup
description: Setup creates only versioned model tags like filemaid-gemma4-26b:va5478cff3f8e, but config and Validate use the untagged name filemaid-gemma4-26b. Ollama then returns 404 when validating or classifying. Setup must also create/maintain an untagged latest alias via ollama cp and keep it when cleaning up stale versions.
close_reason: Setup now creates and preserves untagged model aliases so config references without tags resolve correctly.

title: Use smaller default model or select by workload
description:
The default model is filemaid-gemma4-26b, a 26B-parameter vision model. Switch the default to filemaid-metadata (qwen2.5:7b, metadata-only) for documents/text files, and invoke a vision model only for image extensions. Alternatively default to filemaid-gemma4-12b instead of the 26B variant. This is likely the single largest inference-time speedup.

Acceptance: default config uses a lighter model, and image files route to a vision model while non-image files route to a faster metadata-only model.
close_reason: Implemented and validated on branch perf/llm-categorization.

title: Investigate LLM response parsing issue
description: Read internal/llm/llm.go and identify why real Ollama responses are failing to parse. Document failure modes before writing fixes.
notes: Finding: /api/chat returns assistant reasoning in a 'thinking' field with embedded JSON and empty content/tool_calls. /api/generate returns clean JSON. Current parseResponse ignores message.content/thinking and only handles message.tool_calls or response.
close_reason: Investigated parsing paths; chat endpoint returns thinking field, generate returns clean JSON. parseResponse ignores content/thinking.

title: Show base model names in setup prompts
description: Setup currently displays filemaid-* model names in prompts and requirements checks. Users don't know what underlying base models these correspond to. Add a mapping and display the base model (e.g., gemma4:26b-a4b-it-qat, qwen2.5:7b) alongside or instead of the filemaid wrapper name.
close_reason: Setup prompts now display the underlying Ollama base model names alongside filemaid wrapper names.

title: Remove filemaid-metadata from vision model choices
description: filemaid-metadata is not a vision model. Setup should not list it in the interactive 'choose a vision model' prompt. It should remain the default text model and still be installable, but the user's choice should be limited to filemaid-gemma4-26b and filemaid-gemma4-12b (or auto-selected metadata-only in low-RAM mode).
close_reason: Setup now offers only vision models for the image-model choice.

title: Clarify setup UX for dual-model selection
description: Setup now installs both a vision model and filemaid-metadata, but the interactive prompt still asks the user to choose 'the model'. Update selectModel prompts, the 'Using model' message, and printRequirementsCheck to clearly explain that filemaid-metadata handles text/documents and the user's choice handles images.
close_reason: Implemented setup UX clarifications and validated on branch perf/llm-categorization.

title: Ensure setup installs and validates all required models
description: With image_model/text_model routing, setup can no longer install only one model. It must install both the selected vision model and filemaid-metadata, and process/scan validation must verify that Model, ImageModel, and TextModel all exist in Ollama. Update createOllamaModels, config overrides, disk-space checks, and llm.Validate accordingly.
close_reason: Implemented, committed, and validated on branch perf/llm-categorization.

title: Group files by model to avoid repeated VRAM loads
description:
If filemaid routes different file types to different models (e.g. metadata-only model for text/documents, vision model for images), processing files in their natural directory order will cause the active model to be unloaded and reloaded on every switch. This defeats much of the speedup.

Acceptance: implement a two-pass (or N-pass) batching strategy in the process/scan path that groups files by the model they will use, then processes each group together so each model is loaded into VRAM at most once per run. This should be designed alongside the workload-routing work in filemaid-7a4.
close_reason: Implemented and validated on branch perf/llm-categorization.

title: Resize image payloads on-the-fly before sending to Ollama
description: buildPrompt in internal/llm/llm.go reads entire image files and base64-encodes them, sending multi-megabyte screenshots to the model. Decode the image in memory, resize it to a max dimension of 512–1024 px, re-encode to base64, and send the smaller payload. The original file on disk must not be modified; all resizing happens in-memory during prompt construction. Also consider making subcategorize_images optional or skipped during large batches.
close_reason: Implemented and validated on branch perf/llm-categorization.

title: Cut retry explosion and shrink generation params
description: Classify currently tries up to 4 strategies (chat/generate × with/without images) per file. Reduce this to a single tool-calling /api/chat path, retrying without images only on image-related failures. Also lower the runtime options in requestChat/requestGenerate: num_predict is 2048 but the Modelfiles already specify 512, and num_ctx 8192 can likely be reduced to 4096 for the short classification prompt.
close_reason: Implemented and validated on branch perf/llm-categorization.

title: Gather real test files for acceptance tests

title: Cache model check and classification results
description: checkModel in internal/llm/llm.go hits /api/tags before every single file, and duplicate or previously-seen files are re-classified on every scan. Cache model availability once per run, and add a hash → Decision cache in the SQLite state repository so identical files (by content hash) reuse prior decisions without another LLM round-trip.
notes: Also applies to Validate() in internal/llm/llm.go (used by commands before processing): the model reachability/availability check should only run once at the start of the run, not per-file or per-command validation call.
close_reason: Implemented and validated on branch perf/llm-categorization.

title: Parallelize classification with bounded worker pool
description: Files are currently classified sequentially in internal/cli/process.go:processPaths, leaving the Ollama connection idle while waiting for each response. Add a bounded worker pool (e.g. 3-5 concurrent workers) to classify multiple files in parallel. Keep the apply/move stage sequential if needed to avoid filesystem races, or split classification and application into distinct pipeline stages.
close_reason: Implemented and validated on branch perf/llm-categorization.
